Package io.github.thatgarlicdude.pacromset.manifest Description

The main package of the JPacROMSetManifest Java library.

This package is used to work with manifests designed for the Pac-Man ROM set. It is a home for the PacROMSetManifest, PacROMSetManifestEntry, and PacROMSetManifests classes. The PacROMSetManifest class is the main class that has categorized lists that contain entries called the PacROMSetManifestEntry class. The PacROMSetManifestEntry class contains data like the expected name and size of a Pac-Man ROM, and the PacROMSetManifests serves as an easy gateway for creating PacROMSetManifest instances, as well as reading and writing them to this system's disk. Additionally, the package has the PacROMSetManifestReader class, which reads .pacromsetmanifest files from disk, and the PacROMSetManifestWriter writes them to disk. The JPacROMSetManifest Java library is used at its core to work with Pac-Man ROM set manifests.

See Also:
